SCIENCE-BASED, NON-JUDGEMENTAL, CAT BEHAVIOR HELP
Much like tech support for computers and devices, I offer support for feline caregivers. My name is Tom Kirby, UW-AAB and I’m a certified animal behavior consultant with a wealth of experience in cat behavior. On this channel, I provide you with the most up to date cat care resources to help you and your feline friends live happier, healthier lives together.
